name: agent-manager.friction-digest
purpose: Rank the recurring deterministic friction fingerprints whose suspected owner is one scenario, over the most recent runs inside a window, with owner-confidence counts and no estimation.

scenario.description: Owning scenario slug to digest: the owner of its tool findings and command profiles (a Vrooli CLI's scenario, or vrooli for the control plane).

window_days.description: The tool-friction window is the last N days. Range [1, 90].

top_n.description: How many findings to report, ranked by their share of the window's harm in their own unit.

policy_version.description: Optional immutable supervision policy version for outcome aggregates.

assumptions: agent-manager is running and its measures/tool-friction binding is reachable from the kernel
tool-friction takes window as a TimeWindow message ({token} or {custom: {from, to}}) and owner narrows its profiles, clusters and findings to one scenario
the tool-friction response is one record (primary field summary) whose findings are already ranked by cost share
each call runs in its own program-runtime session; session variables persist across submissions
the caller reads an empty digest beside coverage: unknown outcomes cannot show failures
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
one tool-friction record is materialized; at most top_n findings are reported
at most outcome_limit (500) supervision outcomes are materialized and transcript bodies are never read
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
an owner with no findings in the window is an empty digest with status ok and its coverage, never an error

signals.coverage: what the profiles could see: command calls and the share with a known outcome; an empty digest is read beside it
signals.profiles_for_scenario: command paths the scenario owns that ran in the window
signals.findings_for_scenario: owner-level tool findings the scenario owns
signals.recurring_count: findings with evidence in 3 or more distinct runs
signals.top_fingerprints: at most top_n of {fingerprint, kind, command_path, description, calls, distinct_runs, cost, cost_unit, cost_share, status}, ranked by cost share
signals.supervision_outcomes: Current bounded outcomes including unassessed observations; null when the read failed
signals.supervision_false_positives: signal predictions whose observed class was non-signal
signals.supervision_false_negatives: non-signal predictions whose observed class was signal
signals.supervision_safety_violations: hard safety violations; any non-zero value blocks promotion
signals.supervision_completion_impact: mean measured completion impact over the bounded slice
signals.supervision_assessed: Assessed current outcomes in the bounded sample
signals.supervision_sample_capped: True when the outcome sample reaches its bound; cannot establish coverage
signals.supervision_calibration_available: Assessed nonempty and uncapped sample; not proof of candidate replay
signals.supervision_outcome_coverage: null until a decision denominator is measured

outputs.evidence: the sensor commands read, with counts; never episode bodies

budget.async_reason: The bounded friction digest can reach the kernel deadline while reading the owner ledger; callers wait once for the terminal result.

fixtures.note: A one-day window on a quiet host is legitimately empty: status ok with findings_for_scenario 0 beside its coverage.
